jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

Forward is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering
to lead our Applications engineering organization. Reporting directly to the SVP of Engineering, you will own an organization of approximately 40 engineers across the US and India responsible for the customer-facing application layer of the Forward platform, spanning both backend and frontend. A significant majority of the organization is based in India, where we expect to continue growing.

This is a broad engineering leadership role with end-to-end accountability for the organization: people, architecture, execution, quality, and delivery. You will lead through engineering managers and senior technical leaders while remaining close enough to the technology to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, and help teams navigate difficult technical problems. You will partner closely with Product Management and UX to shape what we build—not simply execute against a roadmap—bringing engineering judgment into product decisions, challenging requirements and priorities when appropriate, and making pragmatic tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Scale the Applications Organization

Lead an approximately 40-person engineering organization across the US and India, including engineering managers and senior technical leaders.
Build a leadership structure that scales, with clear ownership, accountability, and fast decision-making — including operating practices that let each region decide and deliver without depending unnecessarily on the other.
Coach and develop engineering managers into strong leaders of people, technology, and execution.
Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional talent and build a cohesive engineering culture across geographies and time zones, with particular focus on growing the team and the leadership bench in India.
Create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, and give teams the context and autonomy to execute effectively.

Own Product Engineering and Delivery

Own Forward's application development end to end: requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing improvement.
Partner with Product Management and UX on product direction, scope, priorities, and delivery plans, constructively challenging assumptions and proposing alternatives that lead to better customer or business outcomes.
Establish realistic plans and estimates, identify dependencies and risks early, and drive predictable execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changes clearly to engineering and company leadership.

Drive Technical Excellence and Quality

Provide technical leadership across a modern application stack, including Java backend services and Svelte-based frontend applications. This is not a coding role, but you should be comfortable reviewing designs, asking difficult technical questions, evaluating tradeoffs, and guiding teams toward scalable, maintainable solutions.
Partner closely with Distinguished Engineers and other senior technical leaders to establish and evolve architecture and engineering standards.
Hold the organization to high standards for performance, scalability, security, maintainability, and user experience, balancing product velocity against technical investment so that short-term decisions do not compromise long-term product health.
Own release readiness and product quality — feature validation, automated testing, regression coverage, performance, security, production readiness — as an engineering responsibility throughout the development lifecycle, partnering with our dedicated QA organization on test strategy, plans, and automation.
Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices (design reviews, code reviews, development workflows, release processes), and use defects, production issues, and customer feedback to identify systemic improvements rather than isolated fixes.

Build an AI-Native Engineering Organization

Continue evolving how the organization applies AI across the software development lifecycle — coding, testing, debugging, code review, and design — to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
Encourage experimentation with AI-assisted development while establishing practices that produce measurable improvements in engineering outcomes.

Required

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers.
Experience leading a sizable, multi-team engineering organization and scaling both the organization and its leadership structure, working through managers and senior individual contributors rather than direct involvement in every project.
Strong technical background building sophisticated enterprise software, with the depth to evaluate architecture and design decisions across backend and frontend systems and effectively challenge senior engineers.
Track record of delivering complex software products with accountability for schedule, quality, and technical outcomes, balancing roadmap delivery against architecture, technical debt, and longer-term engineering investments.
Experience partnering closely with Product Management and UX/Design, including influencing product requirements, priorities, scope, and strategy.
Strong organizational and planning skills across multiple initiatives, dependencies, resources, and risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including conveying technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and organizational issues to senior leadership.
A leadership style built around ownership, high standards, transparency, and developing strong leaders.

Nice to Have

Experience building on-premises or self-hosted enterprise software.
Experience leading engineering organizations distributed across the US and India.
Experience building applications using Java and modern frontend frameworks.
Experience with networking concepts, including Layer 2/3 protocols, network infrastructure, network security, or network visibility and management products.
Experience applying AI tools across the software development lifecycle and driving adoption across engineering teams.

Location

This is a regular, full-time position with Forward. Our headquarters are in Santa Clara, California; employees based near the office currently work from the office two days per week. We are also open to remote candidates in the United States. The role requires occasional travel, including approximately 1–2 trips to India per year.

Base Salary Range:
$270,000 – $350,000 per year

This range represents the low and high end of the salary for this position. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including location, candidate experience, skills, and level. In addition to the base salary, you will also receive an annualized bonus.

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.

Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.

About Thea Energy

Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future.

Position Overview

Thea Energy is seeking a Director - HTS Magnet Engineering to provide strategic and technical leadership over the design, build, and test of high temperature superconducting (“HTS”) magnets — the foundational component of Thea Energy’s planar coil stellarator. This role owns the magnet engineering roadmap end-to-end, manages engineering managers and cross-functional workstreams, and partners with executive leadership to align magnet development with company-wide program milestones. The Director will build organizational capability as the team scales rapidly, own key vendor and supply chain relationships, and represent magnet engineering in front of investors, partners, and technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibility Areas

Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of the HTS magnet engineering program in alignment with company-wide fusion system milestones for Eos and Helios planar coil stellarator systems
Ensure the magnet product roadmap drives synergy in our technology decisions between Eos and our powerplant Helios
Lead, develop, and scale a multi-level organization of engineering managers, engineers, and analysts
Decompose and develop magnet specifications and technical requirements based on overall system design and performance goals of Eos
Provide senior technical oversight of Multiphysics analyses, design tooling, and data infrastructure supporting magnet development for the Eos magnet systems
Drive design-for-manufacturing strategy and oversee transition from first builds to scalable production
Own key vendor and supplier relationships for magnet hardware, negotiating quotes and ensuring delivery against qualification requirements
Direct tooling, manufacturing, and test infrastructure investments needed to support the magnet program
Define and oversee execution of the magnet testing strategy, including qualification and reliability testing
Own program-level tracking and reporting of progress, risk, budget, and milestones to executive leadership
Represent magnet engineering to internal stakeholders, investors, external partners, and the broader fusion community
Partner with adjacent engineering, physics, and operations teams to ensure magnet development is integrated with overall stellarator design

Ideal Experience & Skillsets

10+ years of engineering experience with magnets, cryogenics, vacuum systems, or transformer design, including significant experience leading engineering organizations
Track record of managing and developing engineering managers and multi-disciplinary technical teams
Deep technical fluency in CAD (Solidworks, CATIA, NX) and Multiphysics simulation (Ansys, COMSOL), sufficient to review and challenge team analyses
Experience owning vendor and supply chain relationships for complex, custom hardware, including machining, welding, and fabrication
Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate system-level performance goals into an executable engineering roadmap
Demonstrated ability to build and scale engineering organizations in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
Comfortable setting aggressive deadlines and driving accountability across multiple teams and workstreams
Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting to executives, investors, or external partners
Innate desire to learn, innovate, and critique ideas — including one’s own and the organization’s
At least a bachelor’s degree in physics, computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred
Experience with magnetic confinement fusion, aerospace, medical devices, or other highly technical, regulated industries is preferred

Company Benefits

Salary range $215,000-$250,000
Comprehensive health benefits (e.g. medical/dental/vision)
Employee equity stock options
20 days PTO

Requirements

Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.
Ability to perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time.
Willingness to occasionally travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call.
Ability to work in a facility that contains industrial hazards including heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, high voltage, high current, pressure systems, and cryogenics.

It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. Please feel free to send us a note and tell us why you would still be a great fit for this role or Thea Energy.

Diversity And Inclusion

Thea Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a company of diverse backgrounds. By creating a diverse environment, we will bring new ideas and approaches to solving some of the world’s hardest (and most important) problems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, family or marital status, age, disability, veteran’s status, or other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations.

Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion!

This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO.

As a Director of Optical Engineering
you will lead the department which staffs the design, development, qualification and commissioning of state-of-the-art UV laser optical systems for laser-driven inertial fusion. This role combines deep technical expertise in optical engineering with organizational leadership responsibility for the Optical Engineering team. You will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of optical engineers while providing technical direction for the design, analysis, integration, and validation of laser beamlines, diagnostics, optical coatings, adaptive optics systems, and other critical optical subsystems.

As a member of the engineering leadership team, you will partner closely with scientists, systems engineers, optical physicists, opto-mechanical engineers, and program leadership to ensure that the optical architectures, technical roadmaps, risks, and delivery of optical systems, is accomplished in accordance with the requirements of Xcimer's Fusion and Directed Energy missions. We are looking for a leader who combines exceptional technical depth with strong people leadership, execution discipline, and a passion for solving some of the world's most challenging engineering problems, while very comfortable working in a matrix organization.

Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, mentor, and grow the Optical Engineering team through hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Establish team goals, priorities, staffing plans, and organizational capabilities aligned with company objectives.
Develop engineering processes, design standards, documentation practices, and quality expectations for the optical engineering organization.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Partner with executive leadership to develop long-term optical engineering strategy and organizational growth plans.

Technical Leadership

Oversee the development of optical architectures for laser beamlines, diagnostics, adaptive optics systems, beam transport systems, and related optical subsystems.
Work with science, systems engineering, and laser teams to derive, allocate, and manage optical system requirements.
Provide technical oversight for optical design, tolerancing, alignment strategies, and system performance analyses.
Chair reviews of optical designs and analyses, ensuring technical rigor and adherence to performance requirements.
Guide development of active beam control systems including adaptive optics, beam stabilization, and tracking systems.
Ensure that requirements and specifications for optical components, coatings, imaging systems, cameras, sensors, and precision optical assemblies are established in compliance with the Xcimer Product Development Process.
Drive resolution of complex optical performance issues through modeling, experimentation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Oversee optical system integration, alignment, verification, validation, and commissioning activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with optomechanical engineering teams to optimize system performance, manufacturability, alignment accessibility, and maintainability.
Collaborate with optical physicists, electrical engineers, controls engineers, and software engineers to develop integrated laser and diagnostic systems.
Support supplier selection, technical evaluations, and strategic relationships with optical component vendors and manufacturing partners.
Work closely with program management to identify risks, develop mitigation plans, and ensure successful execution of program milestones.
Present technical status, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership and executive stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education: MS degree in Optical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Experience: 10+ years of experience in optical engineering, including optical design, analysis, integration, and testing of complex optical systems.
Leadership: 15+ years of experience leading technical teams and managing engineering organizations.
Demonstrated expertise using optical design software such as Zemax (preferred), CODE V, or equivalent tools.
Strong experience with computational analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar engineering software.
Deep understanding of optical design methodologies, optimization techniques, and performance metrics for imaging and laser systems.
Experience with optical tolerancing, fabrication specifications, statistical performance analysis, and alignment sensitivity assessments.
Experience integrating and aligning complex optical systems using instrumentation such as theodolites, autocollimators, laser trackers, interferometers, and related metrology equipment.
Experience performing optical metrology and characterization, including interferometric measurements, surface quality assessment, scatter characterization, and precision inspection techniques.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering efforts from concept through integration and testing.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

Ph.D. degree in Optical Engineering, Optical Science, Physics, or a related discipline.
15+ years of experience in optical system design, optimization, tolerancing, integration, and precision alignment.
Experience working in a Matrix Organization delivering multiple projects and programs in parallel.
Experience leading optical engineering organizations supporting large-scale technical programs.
Experience designing adaptive optics systems and beam pointing stabilization systems.
Experience performing high-fidelity physical optics modeling and wavefront propagation analyses in both near-field and far-field regimes.
Experience with high-energy laser systems and deep ultraviolet (UV) optical systems.
Experience developing comprehensive end-to-end optical system models and performance budgets.
Experience defining and flowing requirements from system-level architectures to subsystem and component specifications.
Experience supporting development of advanced scientific, aerospace, defense, fusion, or directed-energy systems.
Demonstrated success scaling engineering teams in fast-paced, high-growth technical organizations.
